name: dynamic-window-resizing
title: Dynamic Window Resizing
description: Hold the hotkey and move the mouse to resize the frontmost window from its lower-right corner. Release to stop.
author: sebastian

commands.name: resize-window
commands.title: Resize Active Window
commands.description: Hold the hotkey and move the mouse to grow/shrink the frontmost window from its lower-right corner. Release the modifiers (or press Escape) to stop.

scripts.build:helper: cd swift-helper && swift build -c release && mkdir -p ../assets && cp .build/release/WindowResizeHelper ../assets/window-resize-helper
